paper_title: Can LLMs Solve longer Math Word Problems Better
caption: : Gemini-Pro

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the relationship between an unspecified variable on the x-axis and informativeness on the y-axis for two different methods labeled "0-CoT" and "CoRe". The x-axis is unlabeled with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 4, with no units specified, and tick marks at intervals of 1. The y-axis is labeled "Informativeness", also on a linear scale, with values ranging from 0.910 to 0.960, and tick marks at intervals of 0.010. The blue dashed line with circular markers represents the "0-CoT" method. Starting from a y-value of approximately 0.960 at x=0, the line shows a downward trend, reaching around 0.910 at x=4. The orange solid line with triangular markers represents the "CoRe" method. This line also begins just above 0.960 at x=0 and exhibits a similar downward trend, concluding at slightly above 0.910 at x=4. Both lines show declines across the x-axis, with data points showing downward movements at each tick mark. There are five markers for each line. A legend is given top right.
